editions.name: cqr2's Playground

editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
editions.editorial: The Fallen Star clings to 6237 coins yet shed 66 today, while one citizen fed the treasury the same amount under the wealth tax. Rain and monsoon drenched the realm, foreign caravans arrived heavy with coin rallying all; the Caravan Collective delayed a critical product launch again; the throne is empty and rebellion meter stands at 20 percent.
